# EvalStudio by HubForge

> Free browser-based creative tools for monitoring, evaluation, learning (MEL), research, technology and AI. Pick a template, personalise it with a live preview, and download.

EvalStudio is a creative studio, not an evaluation consulting service or a general-purpose AI chatbot. HubForge is its parent ecosystem. These public pages describe real working tools; no account is required.

## Studios
- [Identity](https://studio.hubforgeglobal.com/identity/): Make a personal evaluation or MEL identity card with your own photo, words and colours. Edit a live preview and download a social-ready PNG, without an account.
- [Sticker Lab](https://studio.hubforgeglobal.com/sticker-lab/): Make personalised monitoring, evaluation and learning stickers. Choose from 32 original templates, edit your words and colours, then download PNG or SVG for free.
- [MEL Meme Maker](https://studio.hubforgeglobal.com/meme-maker/): Create workplace-safe monitoring, evaluation and learning memes. Personalise 12 original compositions and download PNG or SVG images. No account needed.
- [Workshop Playbox](https://studio.hubforgeglobal.com/workshop-playbox/): Make editable evaluation bingo, reflection prompts, voting cards and Theory of Change activities. Download A4 PNG or SVG pages, or print workshop materials.

## Practical details
- Editors require JavaScript. Their public studio guides do not.
- PNG and SVG downloads are generated in the browser.
- Workshop activities can be printed or saved as PDF through the browser print dialog.
- Personalised text, favourites and saved creations stay on the visitor's device.
- There is no required paid AI runtime service. The panda provides curated suggestions, not generative AI chat.
- Downloading or sharing an image does not install a WhatsApp sticker pack.
- Identity is an available editor. Fieldwork Kit is not available yet.
